integration_principle: new_fragment -> parse -> reconcile -> classify -> architectural impact -> implement/design/research/reject -> validate -> persist

current_input.note: The current instruction establishes the integration contract. It is not itself external empirical evidence and must not be represented as such. Future Perplexity fragments are appended and reconciled here rather than replacing this record.
